purpose: Decide whether graph-attention weights have enough freshness and decision-relevance evidence to be presented as explanations.

decision_meaning.ELIGIBLE: All required checks passed within the stated scope.
decision_meaning.WITHHOLD: Evidence failed at least one required check; keep attention internal.
decision_meaning.INCOMPLETE: Required evidence is missing or unreadable; no release decision is possible.

check_status_meaning.PASS: The required evidence supports the check.
check_status_meaning.FAIL: The required evidence contradicts the release rule.
check_status_meaning.INDETERMINATE: The evidence is complete but does not support a direction.
check_status_meaning.NOT APPLICABLE: The check is outside the declared deployment scope.
check_status_meaning.INCOMPLETE: Evidence required for the check is missing or unreadable.

checks.name: Evidence integrity
checks.purpose: Confirm that the evidence is complete, reproducible, and valid for analysis.
checks.evidence: All 3 checkpoint sweeps passed experiment preflight.
checks.decision_rule: Every frozen checkpoint sweep must pass preflight. This is not an explanation-release decision.

checks.name: Freshness is visible
checks.purpose: Prevent attention strength from being mistaken for data freshness.
checks.evidence: Freshness is reported separately in 12 stale-exposed condition rows; 10,832 records were audited.
checks.decision_rule: AoI-derived exposure and stale-attention measurements must be present and non-empty.

checks.name: Action-aware controls
checks.purpose: Avoid treating request deletion and taxi-information deletion as equivalent interventions.
checks.evidence: Type matching, chosen-action protection, raw attention, and LOO controls are present.
checks.decision_rule: All sweeps must use type matching and chosen-action protection, with a LOO positive control.

checks.name: Decision relevance
checks.purpose: Check whether the displayed node ranking is more informative than its type-matched random control.
checks.evidence: Default self-row attention did not beat its random control for dispatch decisions: clean CI95 lower=-0.00367092, outage_60s CI95 lower=-0.00371481.
checks.decision_rule: The 95% CI lower bound of dispatch-action margin-DEF must exceed 0 for clean and 60-second outage observations.

checks.name: Action composition
checks.purpose: Stop a no-op majority from hiding the result for actual dispatch actions.
checks.evidence: Reported 26,278 no-op and 2,020 dispatch decisions separately.
checks.decision_rule: Both strata must be reported and dispatch must contain at least 1 decisions.

checks.name: Attention extraction stability
checks.purpose: Check that the conclusion is not created by an arbitrary layer, head, or rollout choice.
checks.evidence: At least one layer/head/rollout choice reverses the default direction for seeds: 42, 43, 44.
checks.decision_rule: The declared self-row mean over layers and heads must not have its direction reversed by an audited alternative.

checks.name: Checkpoint consistency
checks.purpose: Treat independently trained policies, rather than repeated decisions, as the replication unit.
checks.evidence: The conclusion is not consistent across checkpoints for: stale-attention response.
checks.decision_rule: Every configured training seed must be present and give the same non-zero direction for dispatch decision relevance and stale-attention response.

checks.name: Deployment-action capability
checks.purpose: Confirm that the explanation belongs to the action rule intended for deployment.
checks.evidence: The audited action rule uses stochastic sampling; argmax results are retained as a descriptive diagnostic.
checks.decision_rule: Require argmax capability only when argmax is the intended deployment action rule.

checks.name: Trigger robustness
checks.purpose: Test whether the result extends beyond the fixed tunnel-trigger mechanism.
checks.evidence: No supported direction reverses between triggers, but at least one interval crosses zero for seeds: 42, 43.
checks.decision_rule: A direction is supported only when its 95% confidence interval excludes zero; supported tunnel and random directions must agree.
